article_title: Raw images, no filters: Why MySpace fans want it back as relaunch hinted

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly examining?
options: Why all modern social networks are closing
Why some fans want a more personal, unfiltered MySpace and what a relaunch would need to offer
How to sell early-2000s merchandise online
Why MySpace is already larger than Facebook again
tasks.correct_answer: Why some fans want a more personal, unfiltered MySpace and what a relaunch would need to offer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת את הגעגוע לחוויית MySpace האישית והלא־מלוטשת ואת השאלה אם השקה מחודשת יכולה להצליח.

tasks.prompt: Which old MySpace feature best represented users' control over their online identity?
options: A feed chosen entirely by an algorithm
Profiles that could not be changed
Highly customised pages with personal layouts and music
Automatic filters on every photograph
tasks.correct_answer: Highly customised pages with personal layouts and music
tasks.explanation_hebrew: היכולת להתאים אישית את העמוד, כולל מראה ומוזיקה, העניקה למשתמשים שליטה וביטוי אישי.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “autonomy” mean when describing MySpace users?
options: Pressure to post every day
A plan to sell the brand
A feeling of nostalgia for old technology
Freedom to control the look and content of their own pages
tasks.correct_answer: Freedom to control the look and content of their own pages
tasks.explanation_hebrew: autonomy פירושה עצמאות ושליטה; כאן הכוונה לחופש של המשתמשים לעצב ולנהל את העמודים שלהם.

tasks.prompt: Who are the current owners reported to be considering a MySpace relaunch?
options: Brothers Tim and Chris Vanderhook
Tom Anderson and Monticah Hawkins
The founders of Facebook
A group of Atlanta estate agents
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הבעלים הנוכחיים, האחים טים וכריס ונדרהוק, אמרו שהם מתכננים לנסות להשיק את MySpace מחדש.

tasks.prompt: Why might nostalgia alone be insufficient for a successful relaunch?
options: Old users have forgotten how to use websites
A lasting platform needs a useful, distinctive experience, not only warm memories
Customised profiles are illegal today
No young people are interested in early-2000s culture
tasks.correct_answer: A lasting platform needs a useful, distinctive experience, not only warm memories
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נוסטלגיה עשויה למשוך תשומת לב ראשונית, אך הצלחה בת־קיימא דורשת בידול וחוויה שאנשים ירצו להמשיך להשתמש בה.

tasks.prompt: What does “algorithmic” suggest about the feeds criticised by some MySpace fans?
options: They are printed on paper
They contain only music
Computer systems decide what content users see
Every user designs the feed by hand
tasks.correct_answer: Computer systems decide what content users see
tasks.explanation_hebrew: algorithmic מתאר פיד שבו אלגוריתם ממוחשב בוחר ומסדר את התוכן, בניגוד לשליטה אישית ישירה.

tasks.prompt: Give two aspects of old MySpace that fans in the article associate with authenticity.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני מאפיינים קונקרטיים הקשורים לחוויה האישית והפחות־מלוטשת של האתר.
expected_points: Users posted raw or less-filtered images
Profiles could be heavily customised to show individual taste
The site felt less controlled by recommendation algorithms

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's case for and against a MySpace comeback in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את משיכת הנוסטלגיה והשליטה האישית לצד הקשיים העסקיים והתחרותיים של השקה מחודשת.
expected_points: Fans remember a personal and creative social-media experience
The owners have hinted at another relaunch but no firm launch date is given
A comeback could appeal to people tired of polished, algorithm-driven feeds
The brand would need differentiation and a sustainable audience in a crowded market

tasks.prompt: Why could early-2000s aesthetics appeal even to younger users who never experienced MySpace firsthand?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסיק כיצד טרנדים מחזוריים, סקרנות וחיפוש אחר חלופה לפלטפורמות מודרניות עשויים למשוך קהל צעיר.
expected_points: Younger people are embracing styles from before their own online experience
The highly personal design contrasts with today's polished feeds
A distinctive retro identity could make the platform feel new to them

tasks.prompt: Based on the article, propose two principles a revived MySpace should follow and explain why each matters.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע שני עקרונות הקשורים ישירות לנושאי הכתבה ולנמק כל אחד מהם.
expected_points: Give users meaningful control and customisation rather than relying only on algorithms
Encourage authentic interaction without reproducing harmful engagement pressure
Offer a clear niche or differentiation that can remain sustainable after the nostalgic launch
